ability.name: The Conquerer's Crown
ability.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **^^Infantry^^** units while they are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Realmwarper's Twist-rune
ability.effect: If the target does not have the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model’s unit.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Infernal Puppet
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target is picked to use a **^^Spell^^** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target as a reaction. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **^^Spell^^** ability.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Wizard^^** within 24" of this unit to be the target.
